name: Luigia Roberto
bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree calls Angelamaria Fede's mother 'Nunzianna Roberto'. It gives her birth as about 1814 in Bisaccia, her marriage to Bartolomeo Fede as 10 Jul 1835, and her parents as Pasquale di Roberto and Antonia Sena (both b. 1777) (S1). Round 3 read the given name in the 1867 act only tentatively as 'Luigia(?)'. One fact supports Nunzianna: Angelamaria named a daughter born c.1885 'Nunzianda', following the southern-Italian custom of naming daughters after grandmothers (S2).

conflicts.assessment: Probably Nunzianna/Annunziata: the FS name has its own sources and the granddaughter Nunzianda (c.1885-1888) carries the name. Re-read the 1867 act before changing.
